desc_zh: 自粘背胶写真材料，1520mm卷宽，120gsm或140gsm底纸，每卷50米。120gsm底纸 USD 13.60/m²；140gsm底纸 USD 14.60/m²。
desc_en: Self-adhesive vinyl in 1520 mm rolls, supplied in 50 m lengths with a 120 gsm or 140 gsm release liner. Reference prices: USD 13.60/m² for 120 gsm liner and USD 14.60/m² for 140 gsm liner.
seo_title_zh: 背胶写真材料批发｜车身贴·广告背胶定制｜YINZAOSUO
seo_title_en: Self-Adhesive Vinyl Wholesale | Specs, Pricing & Custom Printing | YINZAOSUO
seo_description_zh: 自粘背胶写真材料：1520mm 宽幅，120gsm / 140gsm 底纸可选，适用于广告画面、车身贴与橱窗贴。面向广告制作商批量供货，规格与价格按询价确认。
seo_description_en: Wholesale self-adhesive vinyl in 1520 mm width and 50 m rolls. Choose a 120 gsm or 140 gsm release liner. Reference prices: USD 13.60/m² and USD 14.60/m² respectively. Enquire about bulk orders and international shipping.

detail_zh.lead: 自粘背胶写真材料，背面带胶、揭开即贴，用于车身贴与整车车贴、橱窗玻璃贴、墙面贴与展板贴等画面。两类可选：高分子背胶更适合整车车身贴和长期画面，单组份背胶性价比高，适合平面贴附与短期促销。材料类型、幅宽与价格按询价确认。
highlights: 两类可选：高分子背胶、单组份背胶
整车车身贴与车身广告画面
橱窗玻璃贴、墙面贴与展板贴等常规应用
可供材料卷材，也可印制成品画面交付
材料类型、幅宽与价格按询价确认
applications: 需要背胶安装的定制画面
finishing: 默认100gsm PVC冷裱膜（黄底离型纸），可选亮膜或哑膜
默认卷装并使用硬质纸筒包装
覆膜材料本身具有高透明、低气味、耐水、耐腐蚀、耐磨、耐刮擦及抗UV等特性；这些描述针对覆膜材料，不代表成品具有未经测试的户外使用寿命。
delivery: 西安同城（以确认下单时间为准）：11:00 前下单当天下午送达，19:00 前次日中午前送达，19:00 后次日下午送达
三环内必达，三环外多数郊区可达；自有封闭式面包车专送，卷材整卷送货上门
江浙沪皖由浙江嘉兴海盐合作工厂发货；其他地区时效按订单确认
标准包装：卷装，内置硬质纸筒；具体包装形式可按订单确认
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、卷装或裁切要求及目的地。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供材料类型、宽度、数量或面积、是否覆膜、油墨选择、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 本页未列具体幅宽、面膜厚度、起订量与价格：这些参数按每笔订单的实际规格确认，询价时请注明材料类型与用途（车身、玻璃、墙面或展板）。需要发票可代开，确认订单时说明即可。长期户外使用的适用性需结合材料类型（高分子/单组份）与具体环境确认。

detail_en.lead: Self-adhesive vinyl with a peel-and-stick backing for full vehicle wraps and vehicle graphics, window and glass graphics, wall graphics and display-board graphics. Two media types are available: polymeric vinyl for vehicle wraps and longer-term graphics, and monomeric vinyl for flat surfaces and short-term promotions. Media type, roll width and pricing are confirmed per enquiry.
highlights: Two media types: polymeric and monomeric vinyl
Full vehicle wraps and vehicle-side advertising
Window and glass graphics, wall graphics and display-board graphics
Supplied as media rolls or as printed finished graphics
Media type, roll width and pricing confirmed per quotation
applications: Custom graphics requiring an adhesive backing
finishing: Standard 100 gsm PVC cold lamination with yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish
Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside

The lamination film itself is described as highly transparent, low-odour, water-resistant, corrosion-resistant, abrasion-resistant, scratch-resistant and UV-resistant. These properties describe the film, not an untested outdoor service life for the finished print.
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished graphics and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Standard packing: rolls on a rigid paper tube; alternative packing can be confirmed per order
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, roll or cut-sheet requirements and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the media type, width, quantity or area, lamination, ink option, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: Roll width, face-film thickness, minimum order quantity and pricing are not listed on this page: they are confirmed against the actual specification of each order, so please state the media type and intended use (vehicle, glass, wall or board) when enquiring. Suitability for long-term outdoor use depends on the media type (polymeric or monomeric) and the installation environment.
